description: This file is a shell script that manages the lifecycle of the 'sysevent_proxy' service, including initialization, start, stop, and restart operations, as well as handling system events related to DNS status.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes the service by retrieving configuration parameters and setting the script file path.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the sysevent proxy service, establishing connection with the appropriate sysevent daemon based on configuration.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the sysevent proxy service, terminating processes and cleaning up.
